evidence: Static inspection of the frozen snapshot. task/task.toml:20-24 is the whole [environment] table: `build_timeout_sec = 600.0`, `network_mode = "public"`, `cpus = 2`, `memory_mb = 4096`; there is no `docker_image` key there or in any other table (task.toml:1-38), and it is key-for-key identical to the frozen template's [environment] table (template task.toml:20-24). A case-insensitive recursive search for `docker_image` over the whole task tree returned no match (grep exit 1); the only TOML files at task depth are task/task.toml and task/tests/scoring.toml, and there is no compose/YAML file that could select an image. The agent Dockerfile has active build steps that therefore do run: task/environment/Dockerfile:1 `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim`, :5-7 apt install, :9-12 `npm install -g ... express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1`, :14-15 `COPY instructions/ /instructions/` and `COPY assets/ /assets/`, :16-23 chmod + git init of /app. It is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff reports no differences), and the COPY sources exist (environment/instructions/*.md, environment/assets/seed_data.json). Adversarial check: the failure mode for this row is a prebuilt image silently skipping the COPY of /instructions and /assets so the agent builds without the brief; with no docker_image key nothing can shadow the Dockerfile, so that mode is absent. No conforming alternative is penalised by this row. This row is a static configuration property; no runtime measurement is required for it and none is claimed (no image build was run or inspected by this reviewer; raw-evidence-index.json was present, sha256 40cecd3b5793cc87838f54e8d95212392dbe36ab2cd30a6f2c14f05c045ba5a5, but was not relied on for this verdict).
